title: Circuit Read Temperature
description: Allows this entity broadcast the temperature of it's contents to the output circuit network.

read_temperature.title: Read Temperature
read_temperature.description: Whether or not to broadcast the current reactor temperature in degrees Celsius to a connected circuit network. What signal the value will be broadcast as is determined by `temperature_signal`.

temperature_signal.title: Temperature Signal
temperature_signal.description: What signal to output this reactors temperature as. Only has an effect if `read_temperature` is `true`.
